## Honesty Check

- [ ] No fake PR, release, shipped, cost, user-notification, or agent-run state.
- [ ] No raw feedback, private data, credentials, tokens, keys, or secret logs.
- [ ] Docs/status/UI copy match what is actually implemented.
- [ ] Partial work is labeled partial and names the remaining gap.

## Risk

- [ ] Touches privacy, auth, secrets, runner execution, merge/release, cost, or user-facing status.
- [ ] Requires maintainer approval before an outward-facing or irreversible action.
